SELECT M.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, M.LOGIN_ID AS loginId, M.NAME AS name, M.DEPARTMENT_ID AS departmentId, M.POSITION_ID AS positionId,
A.ASSIGNMENT_ID AS assignmentId, A.ASSIGNMENT_TITLE AS assignmentTitle, TO_CHAR(A.START_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startDate, TO_CHAR(A.DUE_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS dueDate,
S.SUBMISSION_ID AS submissionId, S.SCORE AS score
FROM MEMBER M JOIN ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION S ON M.MEMBER_ID = S.MEMBER_ID JOIN ASSIGNMENT A ON S.ASSIGNMENT_ID = A.ASSIGNMENT_ID
WHERE 1=1
AND M.NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND (
(#{keyword} LIKE '%인사%' AND M.DEPARTMENT_ID = 'D01') OR (#{keyword} LIKE '%개발%' AND M.DEPARTMENT_ID = 'D02') OR (#{keyword} LIKE '%디자인%' AND M.DEPARTMENT_ID = 'D03') OR (#{keyword} LIKE '%영업%' AND M.DEPARTMENT_ID = 'D04') OR (#{keyword} LIKE '%마케팅%' AND M.DEPARTMENT_ID = 'D05') OR (#{keyword} LIKE '%운영%' AND M.DEPARTMENT_ID = 'D06') OR (#{keyword} LIKE '%품질%' AND M.DEPARTMENT_ID = 'D07') OR (#{keyword} LIKE '%전략%' AND M.DEPARTMENT_ID = 'D08')
)
AND (
(#{keyword} LIKE '%사원%' AND M.POSITION_ID = 'P01') OR (#{keyword} LIKE '%주임%' AND M.POSITION_ID = 'P02') OR (#{keyword} LIKE '%대리%' AND M.POSITION_ID = 'P03') OR (#{keyword} LIKE '%과장%' AND M.POSITION_ID = 'P04') OR (#{keyword} LIKE '%차장%' AND M.POSITION_ID = 'P05') OR (#{keyword} LIKE '%부장%' AND M.POSITION_ID = 'P06')
)
ORDER BY M.MEMBER_ID ORDER BY M.LOGIN_ID ORDER BY M.NAME ORDER BY M.DEPARTMENT_ID ORDER BY M.POSITION_ID ORDER BY A.ASSIGNMENT_TITLE ORDER BY A.START_DATE ORDER BY A.DUE_DATE ORDER BY S.SCORE DESC ORDER BY A.DUE_DATE DESC

SELECT M.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, M.LOGIN_ID AS loginId, M.NAME AS name, M.DEPARTMENT_ID AS departmentId, M.POSITION_ID AS positionId,
A.ASSIGNMENT_ID AS assignmentId, A.ASSIGNMENT_TITLE AS assignmentTitle, A.DESCRIPTION AS description, TO_CHAR(A.START_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startDate, TO_CHAR(A.DUE_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS dueDate, A.MAX_SCORE AS maxScore,
S.SUBMISSION_ID AS submissionId, S.CONTENT AS submittedContent, S.SCORE AS score, S.FILE_ID AS submittedFileId,
F.ORIGINAL_NAME AS submittedFileName
FROM MEMBER M JOIN ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION S ON M.MEMBER_ID = S.MEMBER_ID JOIN ASSIGNMENT A ON S.ASSIGNMENT_ID = A.ASSIGNMENT_ID LEFT JOIN ATTACHMENT F ON S.FILE_ID = F.FILE_ID
WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND A.ASSIGNMENT_ID = #{assignmentId}
SELECT FILE_ID, ORIGINAL_NAME, CHANGED_NAME, FILE_PATH FROM ATTACHMENT WHERE FILE_ID = #{fileId}
